CustomField.description: This field will be a single field that holds all EQF scores on the Credit Review and displays them in one field. This is for the B of I Reporting.
CustomField.formula:
IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PG_1_EQF_Score__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(PG_2_EQF_Score__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(PG_3_EQF_Score__c))), PG_1_EQF_Score__c + ', ' + PG_2_EQF_Score__c + ', ' + PG_3_EQF_Score__c,
IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PG_1_EQF_Score__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(PG_2_EQF_Score__c))), PG_1_EQF_Score__c + ', ' + PG_2_EQF_Score__c,
PG_1_EQF_Score__c))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will be a single field that holds all EQF scores on the Credit Review and displays them in one field. This is for the B of I Reporting.
CustomField.label: All EQF Fico Scores
